constraints: If archivePath is omitted, an open-file dialog box lets the user select the archive to restore.
archivePath/destFolderPath must be expressed with system syntax (absolute, or relative to the database structure file).

If destFolderPath is omitted (but archivePath given), the standard restore dialog appears with the archive pre-selected so the user can choose the destination folder; if destFolderPath is also passed, a preconfigured dialog appears where the user can only launch or cancel.
Sets the OK and Document system variables: OK=1 and Document set to the restore folder pathname on success; OK=0 otherwise.

jointConstraints.rule: destFolderPath is only meaningful when archivePath is also passed; passing destFolderPath suppresses the destination-folder chooser step of the restore dialog.
